** TMI degradation and lifetime**

** Note 1 : The annotation *on the item of dtemperature_avg means the total temperature has been higher than 150 C.
** Note 2 : The annotation **on the item of dtemperature_avg means odind, gpocrdx, and a larger-than-one nf are co-existed. TMI will set nf equal to one.
